content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Leavenworth

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience. Review PMI's education and hours requirements to verify you qualify before enrolling in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP® bootcamp. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule, covering all PMBOK® Guide domains. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world context relevant to Leavenworth's military, defense, and public-sector employers.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, create your PMI account and submit your PMP® application with your education and experience documentation. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Approval typically follows within days.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam and complete it at an approved testing center on a date that works for you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over each three-year cycle by completing training, volunteering, or serving on PMI committees. Renew your certification before expiration to keep your PMP® credential current and competitive in your career.
